name: Voicebox
description: Local voice-cloning studio (Qwen3-TTS and other engines) with a local HTTP API; used to render narration in a cloned voice.

install.setup: Install the Voicebox app (https://voicebox.sh), create a cloned voice profile, and leave the app running.

profile.description: Default voice profile name or id for narration

invocation.summary: POST /generate with a profile id and text, poll /history/<id> until completed, then download /audio/<id> (WAV).

io.input: Narration text and a voice profile
io.output: WAV audio (the tested install writes 24 kHz mono 16-bit PCM)

limitations: The Voicebox app must be running; its server only listens on localhost.
Voice quality and consent for the cloned voice are the user's responsibility; Nexus only sends text to the local server.
